assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production inventory charm sprite for Hero Siege, original pixel-art reinterpretation of the user's named visual reference. Actual transparent RGBA PNG; no background, checkerboard, ground, text, label, border or watermark. Old-school dark fantasy game pixel art, clear charcoal outline, hard square color clusters, restrained palette and upper-left highlights. No antialiasing, blur, photorealism, smooth gradients or fuzzy halo. Only one item, fully visible and centered with small transparent padding. Think in native logical pixels, enlarged only with nearest-neighbor pixel blocks. Visual reference: Tinker Bell. Pocket Elf should now be a tiny slender female fairy with golden blonde hair in a high bun, pointed ears, a simple bright leaf-green dress with a jagged petal hem, small green slippers with a light pompom, and a delicate pair of translucent-looking pale ice-blue insect fairy wings (represented by solid pixel color clusters for a crisp sprite). Friendly confident expression, a compact graceful hovering three-quarter pose, arms close to her body. This should clearly evoke the classic blonde green-dress fairy look. No green hat, long braided hair, trousers, backpack, boots, elf warrior outfit or wand. Keep whole fairy including wings and feet visible, readable at exactly 32 x 32 pixels with a one-pixel transparent margin; oversized head enough for readability but elegant fairy proportions, not a baby or broad chibi. Treat the image as a 32x32 pixel icon, not an illustration with tiny fine lines.
